liver function and albumin/globulin: albumin 35.1 g/L (ref 35-52), globulin 30.8 g/L RAISED (ref 15-30), A/G ratio 1.14 LOW (ref 1.2-2.4)

full blood count: normal
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acquired hepatocerebral degeneration with manganese deposition in the basal ganglia, secondary to cirrhosis (likely portal-systemic shunting).

Alternatives I would still consider:
1. Wilson disease (atypical presentation with negative copper studies and no KF rings, but liver disease + extrapyramidal features keep it in the differential pending further work-up)
2. Cerebellar tremor from an occult structural lesion (though MRI showed no cerebellar lesion)
3. Idiopathic Parkinson disease with coincidental chronic liver disease (less likely given the coarse intention component and symmetrical basal ganglia signal change)
